email.subject: Updated CV - Application for UI/UX Designer
email.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find my CV attached for the UI/UX Designer position. This is an updated version of the CV I sent earlier.

Regards,
Waleed Nasir

facts.name: Waleed Nasir
facts.education: Bachelor of Design, University of the Punjab, 2021

ux-1.proof: Bachelor of Design, University of the Punjab, 2021

ux-3.proof: Design the screens of a home-services app in Figma, from wireframes to interactive prototypes.

ux-5.proof: Interviewed 14 customers, ran usability tests, and rebuilt booking as a responsive flow that meets WCAG 2.1 AA.

ux-6.proof: Work with the front-end developers and the product team in two-week sprints.

why: The second of two applications from the same person (the first is jk-08a). The CV is changed: a new title and one more line, which earns one more tick (ux-6). The file is different, so the duplicate-file rule does not catch it. What the product does with the pair is decided in task 27.
